verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents a first-party path for connecting coding tools via Nexus CLI, and its OpenAI-compatible endpoint is positioned as a drop-in replacement, so it can plug into coding agents. There is no evidence of first-party integration guides for specific agent frameworks; the function-calling docs are generic building blocks, not framework guides. Missing for 10: named first-party guides for specific coding agents and agent frameworks (e.g., per-tool setup pages), detail on how deep the Nexus CLI integration goes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug the provider into coding agents and agent frameworks through documented, first-party integration guides

citations.quote: Connect coding tools with Nexus CLI, choose Fireworks models directly or through Nexus Auto, and manage supported serverless usage.
Fireworks provides an OpenAI compatible endpoint.
A drop-in replacement for closed-model APIs. Route to the best open or closed model for every task, and cut your AI coding spend 50 to 75%.
